facts.fact: Carson 观察到距离节日开始还有「two weeks」（两周），Marigold Ranch 换掉了南牧场最歪的栅栏柱、修好了腐烂的干草车板，开始像他长大的那个牧场。
facts.anchor: It was two weeks until the festival started.

facts.fact: Beau 给 Carson 发短信「Tell your cow I expect an apology.」，并附一张照片：Carson 的一头牛把鼻子伸过栅栏、嘴里叼着 Beau 的工作手套。
facts.anchor: One of our cows stood behind the fence with her nose pushed through the boards.

facts.fact: Clover 三天前（three days ago）邀请 Carson 去她家吃晚饭，不是 Jones 家族聚餐也不是节日会议，Carson 差点拒绝但最终答应了。
facts.anchor: Clover had invited me to her house for dinner three days ago.

facts.fact: Carson 登门时 Clover 端出三杯酒（three glasses），Hunter 做了烤鸡配土豆和蔬菜，Clover 贡献了从 Sugar and Pine 拿回加热的面包。
facts.anchor: Clover appeared carrying three glasses before he could say anything.

facts.fact: 晚饭后 Hunter 调整右膝处的假肢接受腔，Clover 问要不要另一个衬垫并起身去卧室拿，Hunter 摸她手腕说自己来（I’ve got it），Clover 没有追问也没有担心。
facts.anchor: Then he reached down and adjusted something near his right knee.

facts.fact: Carson 向 Clover 坦白自己失去了左腿（I lost my left leg），时间是五年前（Five years），Clover 的视线落到她的牛仔裤和靴子上，说完全不知道。
Hunter 告诉 Carson，Beau 曾开车三小时（three hours），只因他们旅行时 Hunter 的一个假肢部件坏了、需要搭车，并非 Hunter 自己解决不了。
facts.anchor: Hunter told me Beau had driven three hours once

facts.fact: 睡前 Beau 连发短信问 Carson 是否上床，Carson 回 Just got in，Beau 说 Good，Carson 道 Goodnight Beau，Beau 回「Night sweetheart, see you tomorrow.」
